summary: Batch A, family A18 (inclusion-maximal cliques), on the fixed A17 pin 1f4e9c1 (no private union). New GTBase.maximal_cliques is a thin adapter over MathComp maxset of cliqueb: maximal_clique S := maxset cliqueb S and nontrivial_maximal_clique S := (1 < #|S|) && maximal_clique S, with maximal_cliqueP (through GraphTheory maxset_properP and cliqueP), the Boolean presentations, the clique projection, no proper clique extension and extension to a maximal clique (maxset_exists). No generic maximality infrastructure or clique predicate is added. X181's Boolean helper keeps its size guard (Boolean equality); XE1's unrestricted Prop helper is reflected (iff); no conversion or propositional extensionality is claimed. The public client separates K_0 (empty set maximal, not nontrivial), K_1 (singleton maximal, not nontrivial), K_n, nonempty edgeless graphs (exactly the singletons) and, in the disjoint K_2 + K_3, a nontrivial inclusion-maximal K_2 that is not maximum (upstream maxcliques) next to the maximum K_3.

Frozen verbatim at 1f4e9c1: both helpers, X181's chains x181_clique_colourable (ffun colouring into 'I_k), x181_clique_chromatic_window (ordinal k, floor logarithms, natural subtraction, both window inequalities) and x181_random_graph_clique_chromatic_constant (exact G(n,1/2) weight under the positive-mass fg_whp), XE1's chains xe1_clique_transversal (its 2 <= #|K| guard outside the helper) and xe1_clique_transversal_number (attained and minimal), and the rows X181 random_graph_clique_chromatic_tight_constant_statement (partial: the documented upper-window defect is kept) and XE1 erdos_151_statement (whole greatest-guarantee hypothesis, truncated subtraction). Complete row: X181Original (texts at C8's baseline 47eed16) composes the frozen helper with C8's frozen monochromatic body through all three chains; XE1's row has no older history. Three whole-row iffs.

History: C8's X181Legacy colourability chain keeps the live x181_maximal_clique byte-for-byte and is documented below; A18's per-row X181 colourability copy keeps C8's live x181_monochromatic and is documented reciprocally in C8's spec. A16's and A17's specs and registries drop exactly their two maximal-clique exclusions (U13 stays). The five C8 X181 certificates and every old proof keep their types. Doc blocks are unchanged.
